_about: Public-domain William Julius Mann (1819-1892), German-American Lutheran pastor in Philadelphia and confessional theologian, for the Word Hoard: A Plea for the Augsburg Confession (1856), Lutheranism in America (1857) and the Life and Times of Henry Melchior Muhlenberg (1887), from Internet Archive scans. His German-language books are left for Adam's ruling. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 54 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

wjmann-plea-augsburg: A plea for the Augsburg Confession : in answer to the objections of the Definite platform ; an address to all ministers and laymen of the evangelical church of the United States (Philadelphia : Lindsay & Blakiston, 1856)
wjmann-lutheranism-america: Lutheranism in America: An Essay on the Present Condition of the Lutheran (Lindsay & Blakiston, 1857)
wjmann-muhlenberg: Life and times of Henry Melchior Muhlenberg. By William J. Mann (Philadelphia, G. W. Frederick, 1887)

_pending.wjmann-german: German-language works (Heilsbotschaft sermons, Die gute alte Zeit in Pennsylvanien, Muhlenbergs Leben, Ein Aufgang im Abendland, Leben William Penns): pending Adam's ruling on non-English works
